color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no modification. Page background #ffffff qualifies for light color register (luminance: 255).

type-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Letter spacing 0.06em injected on all heading levels (h1, h2). Proprietary fonts replaced: meno-banner → Cormorant Garamond, commuters-sans → Raleway, proxima-nova → Inter, Helvetica → Work Sans. swiper-icons, ETmonarch, ETmodules, FontAwesome removed (non-design fonts). All fonts use Google Fonts CDN @import.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Duration scaling ×1.3 for a more languid, measured pacing. All transition and animation durations scaled: 0.5s → 0.65s, 0.2s → 0.26s, 0.3s → 0.39s, 0.4s → 0.52s, 0.9s → 1.17s, 0.1s → 0.13s. Easing normalized to ease-in-out throughout.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Container max-width tightened by 15% (950px → 807px) for a more editorial, column-focused reading experience. Padding unchanged.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Global scale factor ×1.35 applied to all numeric spacing values (padding, margin, gap). Creates a more generous, breathing layout — nav columnGap 48px → 64px, section padding 18px → 24px, wrapper padding 32px → 43px, CTA padding 22px → 30px, footer paddingBottom 64px → 86px.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist D: Hover opacity 0.75 added to all link hover states. No color values changed. Transition explicitly set to 'all 0.3s ease-in-out' for consistency.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist D: Letter spacing 0.08em added to nav link typography. Nav geometry built from scratch with height 60px/48px scrolled, paddingInline 24px, sticky position, left logo position. Underline hover animation with 0.3s duration.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C: Material shift applied to Pattern 2 paragraph — added specific detail about Cormorant Garamond's hairline strokes as physical analogue to copper engraving plate, introducing tactile and material vocabulary into the analysis. concept_by_video.md generated fresh with copper-material aesthetic vocabulary throughout all sections.

productConcept.note: Product concept to be assigned by landing page skill
